response.agreement_with_paper: Equilibrium scour depth S_eq/D=0.247 from Sumer-Fredsoe-Christiansen (1992) formula agrees with the CFD's asymptotic target of ~0.15 only within a factor of ~1.6 (formula over-predicts); KC=13.02, theta=0.173, non-breaking classification, and bedload flux magnitude are all consistent with paper inputs; time-series shape is reproduced with one fitted parameter (T*=1054 s) at RMS residual 0.010 in S/D, but T* required fitting rather than prediction.
gaps: Full 3D OpenFOAM CFD not rerun; only analytical/semi-analytical surrogates used
Equilibrium S_eq/D from Sumer formula (0.247) exceeds paper's CFD result (~0.15) by ~60%, suggesting the CFD model does not simply recover the Sumer empirical formula
Time-scale T* required fitting to Fig 10(b) rather than being independently predicted; analytic T* under-predicts approach rate by ~3x
Sections 6.2 and 6.3 (breaking-wave cases, which are the novel claims of the paper) not addressed at all
Fig 10(b) curve values read from paper figure rather than from raw simulation data; plot digitization not performed
Suspended-load and Exner bed-morphology components verified only in structure, not in quantitative output
No access to released code or data; reproducibility blocked by non-disclosure of CFD implementation
response.recommendation: The replication independently validates key input physics and the equilibrium scour scaling but cannot confirm the paper's primary contribution (3D CFD of breaking-wave scour) without the actual simulation code; accept as a plausibility spot-check of §6.1 only, not a full replication.
